name: leaselens
description: LeaseLens — AI maintenance triage and lease abstraction (local MVP)

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @leaselens/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w @leaselens/shared" "npm run dev -w @leaselens/api" "npm run dev -w @leaselens/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @leaselens/shared && npm run build -w @leaselens/api && npm run build -w @leaselens/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @leaselens/shared && npm run test -w @leaselens/api
